author: Marina, mother of two
text: After switching to website payment we got our code right away and activated protection for the kids. Time limits and alerts about blocked sites really help.

author: Igor S.
text: AI tips constantly remind us about digital hygiene. I like that there's no extra data entry — just alias and PIN.

author: The Kovalev family
text: 10 devices and a single family report. The activation code arrived instantly, and Telegram support replies within a couple of minutes.
